27 December 2024

## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Associated Entities

## Revised Business and Risk Management Questionnaire and New Analysis of Scheme Assets for Associated Entity of an RA13 Intermediary

The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) today published (i) a revised Business and Risk Management Questionnaire (BRMQ) for licensed corporations (LCs) and associated entities (AEs) 1 ; and (ii) an analysis of scheme assets for associated entity of an intermediary licensed or registered for Type 13 regulated activity in relation to the carrying on by the intermediary of Type 13 regulated activity (an RA13 Intermediary).

## BRMQ

The revisions to the BRMQ 2  are made primarily for the implementation of the RA13 regime. All LCs and AEs should use the revised BRMQ (see Annexes 1a and 1b) for financial years ending on or after 31 December 2024 and submit the BRMQ electronicially to the SFC via WINGS.

## Analysis of Scheme Assets for Associated Entity of an RA13 Intermediary

A Gazette notice (see Annex 2) was published today to specify that, the form of the analysis of scheme assets for associated entity of an intermediary licensed or registered for Type 13 regulated activity in relation to the carrying on by the intermediary of Type 13 regulated activity shall be used for financial years ending on or after 31 December 2024.

The form is available on the SFC website:

[https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/Intermediaries/Analysis-of-scheme-assets-for-associated-entityof-an-RA13-intermediary](https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/Intermediaries/Analysis-of-scheme-assets-for-associated-entity-of-an-RA13-intermediary)

Should you have any questions regarding the contents of this circular, please contact the case officers in charge.

Intermediaries Supervision Department Intermediaries Division Securities and Futures Commission

Enclosure

End

SFO/IS/043/2024

1 The electronic BRMQ is available here for LCs and here for AEs.

2 BRMQ is a supervisory tool the SFC uses to gather data and information to better understand the industry landscape, monitor market trends and identify emerging issues. Pursuant to Section 156(1)(a) and (b) of the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) as amplified by the Securities and Futures (Accounts and Audit) Rules, LCs and AEs are required to complete a BRMQ and submit to the SFC within four months after the end of each financial year.
